title: stream7
summary: A Python data pipeline (step2.py, step3.py, app.py) that preprocesses tabular data, applies class-imbalance oversampling, and generates synthetic records; it imports SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and Metadata classes directly and evaluates results with evaluate_quality, and it also uses the standalone rdt package's ClusterBasedNormalizer and OneHotEncoder transformers for preprocessing.
